blocks.text: In addition to a robust set of preconfigured dashboards that allow you to monitor your organization's security profile at a glance using a variety of graphs and charts, you can also create customized dashboards so you can focus on the metrics most important to you.
Custom dashboards have the following benefits and enable you to:

blocks.item: Create personalized dashboard views with the metrics most important to you.
View real-time data so that you can detect security issues early and take action when necessary.
Collaborate and share dashboards with others in your organization in similar or related job functions.

blocks.text: On the Custom Dashboards page (Analytics> Custom Dashboards), you can do the following:

blocks.item: Filter the list of custom dashboards by selecting one or more criteria. Click the plus (+) icon to display more criteria if some are hidden.

Last Modified: Select a time range between Last 1 Day or Last 90 Days, or select Custom and use the calendar to specify a different time range. Custom dashboards created or modified within the time range will be shown in the list. When you open a dashboard, you can filter the data displayed.
Created By: Select one or more users who have created dashboards you want in the list.
Data Source: Select one or more data source types (e.g., Networking, Cybersecurity, Operational, etc,) for the dashboards you want in the list.
Favorite: Select whether you want to view only the dashboards you have marked as a Favorite in the list.

Created On: Select a time range between Last 1 Day or Last 90 Days, or select Custom and use the calendar to specify a different time range. Custom dashboards created within the time range will be shown in the list.
Clear: Click to remove all filters and display all custom dashboards you have access to.
Create a new custom dashboard.
Search for a dashboard. Enter text that matches part of the name or description of a custom dashboard to display it in the list, filtered as specified above.
Show or hide the columns in the list of dashboards. Available options are:
Show All Columns: All available columns are shown.
Name: The name of the custom dashboard. This column cannot be hidden.
Created By: The user who created the custom dashboard.
Created On: The date the custom dashboard was created.
Last Modified: The date the custom dashboard was last modified.
Shared With: The number of users the dashboard is shared with. You can click the link to see the users who have access to the dashboard. To learn more, see Sharing a Custom Dashboard.

Data Source: The data source types for the widgets on the dashboard, which correspond to the categories of analytics dashboards (i.e., Networking, Cybersecurity, Risk360, Digital Experience, Data Security, and Operational). Custom dashboards can contain widgets from multiple data sources.
Favorite: Indicates if you have marked the dashboard as a favorite.
Action: Actions (share, rename, duplicate, or delete) you can take for this dashboard. This column cannot be hidden.
The list of custom dashboards that you created and that have been shared with you. If you have applied any filters, only those dashboards will be shown.
Mark a custom dashboard as a Favorite by clicking the icon (), then use the filters to show only your favorite dashboards.
Share a dashboard for viewing or collaboration.
Modify, rename, duplicate, or delete an existing custom dashboard.
